provenance.fields: per-field: source (assembly), version, checkedAt, confidence, value
provenance.note: confidence=verified-schema means the field exists and is written by Unity according to the assembly; value=null means the instance value is unknown (Unity 6 / SerializedFile v22 container not parsed yet).
provenance.extractedValues: confidence=extracted means every decoded instance of the class agreed on the value; the field layout was accepted only when it consumed the object payload exactly.
